AMARU✳AMAZON EXPERIENCES

THE TRAVELLERS BEHIND AMARU

Two travellers. An Amazon connection.

After travelling through different places, we found a different rhythm in Puerto Nariño: listening to the river, walking without hurry and looking at nature with curiosity.

We are two travellers who love nature. Amaru grew from that connection with the Colombian Amazon and the wish to share it through river outings, forest walks and local encounters, with local guides.

Tell us what interests you and how much time you have. Together we shape a proposal around your activities and the accommodation, meals and services you choose to arrange, subject to availability and local conditions.

A journey that feels like you↗

RIVER & LAKEDAYTIME

Lake Tarapoto

Follow the waterways in search of river dolphins and the quiet beauty of the lakes.

Low effort

Quick view↗

Explore Lake Tarapoto by day, with time for the waterside landscapes and the search for river dolphins. This experience centres on the lake and its wildlife, rather than paddling or forest trails. Dolphins live in the wild, so each outing is different and sightings are never guaranteed.

  • River and lake landscapes
  • Dolphin watching when conditions allow
  • Meeting point and duration confirmed together

Kaya · daytime paddling

Slow down on the water. A daylight kayaking experience, shaped by the river.

Quick view↗

Amazonian cacao

FOREST & WILDLIFEAFTER DARK

Wochine & rainforest night walk

Begin at Wochine Reserve, then discover the forest after dark with a local guide. One combined experience, with a return rather than an overnight stay.

Moderate to high effort

Quick view↗

This outing combines a visit to Wochine Reserve with a guided night walk. As daylight fades, the forest is experienced through sounds, movement and close observation. BEFORE YOU FOLLOW THE RIVER

A few things to know.

Let’s talk↗
How do I get from Leticia to Puerto Nariño?

Travel to Leticia, then continue along the Amazon by boat to Puerto Nariño. Amaru can coordinate river tickets and meeting arrangements when they form part of your proposal. Confirm the departure point, current timetable and connection margins before buying onward tickets. River conditions can affect the journey.

When should I visit?

The river changes throughout the year. Higher water can open routes through flooded forest; lower water offers different walking routes and river landscapes. Tell us your dates and we will explain what is possible at that time. Rain is part of the experience.

How many days should I stay?

For a slower visit, the Amaru team recommends around five days and four nights in Puerto Nariño. This is a planning suggestion, not a compulsory package: tell us your dates and interests so we can discuss what fits your time and the conditions of the river.

Which services can be arranged?

A proposal can bring together local guiding, river transport, entrance fees and equipment, with accommodation and meals when requested. Inclusions depend on the activities and services contracted. Review exactly what is included, what is paid separately and the full price before confirming.

Do I need to bring specialist equipment?

Depending on the activity, the proposal may include boots, rain capes, hammocks or torches. Ask which items, sizes and quantities are available and what you need to bring. The equipment and food for a forest night must be specified for that overnight experience.

Can I arrange a guide in my language?

Let us know your preferred language when you enquire. We will confirm guide or interpreter availability and any additional cost before you book. The language of this website does not guarantee a guide in that language.

What should I bring?

Bring light, quick-drying clothes, long sleeves, walking footwear, sun and insect protection, a reusable water bottle, personal toiletries and a waterproof bag. Carry your personal documents and any regular medication. Discuss individual health needs with a healthcare professional before travelling. Ask for the packing list for the experiences you choose.

Night walk or overnight stay: what is the difference?

A night walk explores the forest after dark and ends with the agreed return; it does not include sleeping in the forest. An overnight experience continues until morning and involves different walking, sleeping and preparation requirements. Choose according to your interests and comfort, and confirm the itinerary with Amaru.

Is kayaking a daytime activity?

Yes. Our Kaya / kayaking experience takes place during daylight. Birdwatching and the cacao tour are separate experiences and can each be requested individually. Routes depend on water levels and weather.

Should I bring cash?

Plan enough Colombian pesos for personal expenses, extra meals, local purchases and unexpected costs. Arrange cash in Leticia before travelling and check accepted payment methods. Internet access in Puerto Nariño can be limited, so save useful contacts and travel details for offline use.

How do pricing and reservations work?

Send your dates, group size and interests on WhatsApp. We will discuss availability and send a personalised proposal with the total price, inclusions, payment conditions and cancellation terms. An enquiry is not a confirmed booking. No payment is collected on this website.
